THE BLACK PRINCE COMMUNITY TRUST The Black Prince Trust is a not-for-profit charity whose primary purpose is to manage and develop the Black Prince Community Hub in Lambeth, south London. PRIVATE HIRE FREE COMMUNITY SESSIONS The Black Prince Trust The Black Prince Trust is a not-for-profit charity providing free daily access to Sport, Physical Activity and Wellbeing activities through its accessible and inclusive Community hub in a socio-economically disadvantaged area of Lambeth. We use physical activity to connect people, boost wellbeing and create positive social change.
